blackwater_notrust.m: Regardless, I cannot help you. My services are only for residents of Blackwater mountain, and I don't trust you enough yet.

mazeg_1.m: Welcome friend! Would you like to browse my selection of fine potions and ointments?
r: Sure. Show me what you have.
I am looking for some Lyson marrow extract, for Hjaldar in Remgard.

mazeg_2.m: Welcome traveller. Have you come to ask for help from me and my potions?
r: Yes. Please show me what you have.
I am looking for some Lyson marrow extract, for Hjaldar in Remgard.

mazeg_d.m: I already sold you some before. Did you lose it? Please tell my old friend Hjaldar that I said hello.

mazeg_e_10.m: Please give my warmest greetings to my good friend Hjaldar. Tell him that I am well.

mazeg_e_2.m: Hjaldar, my old friend! Tell me, how is he these days?
r: He asked me to relay his greetings to you, and to tell you that he is well.
He is sick, and getting worse every day.

mazeg_e_3.m: Oh, I am so glad to hear that! We sure did have some nice times while working together.

mazeg_e_4.m: I'm sorry to hear that. He always seemed like a tough old boy to me.

mazeg_e_5.m: You asked for some Lyson marrow extract.

mazeg_e_7a.m: Since you helped us up here in the Blackwater mountain settlement earlier, I am willing to give you a discount on the price for some Lyson marrow extract. For 400 gold, I am willing to sell you some of it for my old friend Hjaldar.
r: Ouch, that much?! Is there anything you can do to lower the price?
I'll return when I have the gold for it.

mazeg_e_7b.m: For 800 gold, I am willing to sell you some of it for my old friend Hjaldar.
r: Ouch, that much?! Is there anything you can do to lower the price?
I'll return when I have the gold for it.

mazeg_e_8a.m: No, 400 gold it is. That's a really good price, considering how hard this stuff is to find. Besides, if it weren't for Hjaldar, I wouldn't even be selling this to you.
r: I'll return when I have the gold for it.

mazeg_e_8b.m: No, 800 gold it is. That's a really good price, considering how hard this stuff is to find. Besides, if it weren't for Hjaldar, I wouldn't even be selling this to you.
r: I'll return when I have the gold for it.

mazeg_e_9.m: Thanks. Here's some of the Lyson marrow extract.

bwm_agent.1: I met a man seeking help for his settlement, the 'Blackwater mountain'. Supposedly, his settlement is being attacked by monsters and bandits, and they need help from the outside.
bwm_agent.5: I have agreed to help the man and Blackwater mountain in dealing with the problem.
bwm_agent.10: The man told me to meet him on the other side of the collapsed mine. He will crawl through the mine shaft and I will descend into the pitch-black abandoned mine.
bwm_agent.20: I have navigated through the pitch-black abandoned mine, and met the man on the other side. He seemed very anxious about telling me to head straight to the east once I exit the mine. I should meet the man at the bottom of the mountain to the east.
bwm_agent.25: I heard a story about Prim and the Blackwater mountain settlement fighting against each other.
bwm_agent.30: I should follow the mountain path up the mountain to the Blackwater mountain settlement.
bwm_agent.40: I met the man again on my way up to Blackwater mountain. I should proceed further up the mountain.
bwm_agent.50: I have made it up to the snow-filled parts of the Blackwater mountain. The man told me to proceed further up the mountain. Apparently, the Blackwater mountain settlement is close by.
bwm_agent.60: I have reached the Blackwater mountain settlement. I should find and talk to their battle master, Harlenn.
bwm_agent.65: I have spoken to Harlenn in the Blackwater mountain settlement. Apparently, the settlement is under attack by a number of monsters, the aulaeth and white wyrms. On top of that, they are being attacked by the people of Prim.
bwm_agent.66: Harlenn thinks the people of Prim are behind the monster attacks somehow.
bwm_agent.70: Harlenn wants me to give a message to Guthbered of Prim. Either the people of Prim stop their attacks on the Blackwater mountain settlement, or they will have to be dealt with themselves. I should go talk to Guthbered in Prim.
bwm_agent.80: Guthbered denies that the people of Prim have anything to do with the monster attacks on the Blackwater mountain settlement. I should go talk to Harlenn.
bwm_agent.90: Harlenn is sure that the people of Prim are behind the attacks somehow.
bwm_agent.95: Harlenn wants me to go to Prim and look for signs that they are preparing for an attack on the settlement. I should go look for clues around where Guthbered stays.
bwm_agent.100: I have found some plans in Prim about recruiting mercenaries and attacking the Blackwater mountain settlement. I should go talk to Harlenn immediately.
bwm_agent.110: Harlenn thanked me for investigating the attack plans.
bwm_agent.120: To make the attacks on the Blackwater mountain settlement stop, Harlenn wants me to assassinate Guthbered in Prim.
bwm_agent.130: I have started a fight with Guthbered.
bwm_agent.131: I told Guthbered that I was sent to kill him, but I let him live. He thanked me deeply, and left Prim.
bwm_agent.149: I have told Harlenn that Guthbered is gone.
bwm_agent.150: Harlenn thanked me for the help I have provided. Hopefully, the attacks on the Blackwater mountain settlement should stop now.
bwm_agent.240: I am now trusted in the Blackwater mountain settlement, and all services should be available for me to use.
bwm_agent.250: I have decided to not help the people of the Blackwater mountain settlement.
bwm_agent.251: Since I am helping Prim, Harlenn no longer wants to talk to me.

sisterfight.10: I heard a story about two squabbling sisters in Remgard, Elwel and Elwyl. Apparently they have kept people awake at night with the way they are shouting at each other. I should go visit them in their house on the southern shore of the city of Remgard.
sisterfight.20: I have talked to Elwyl, one of the Elwille sisters in Remgard. She is furious at her sister for not agreeing on even the most simple of facts. Apparently, they have had their disagreements with each other for several years.
sisterfight.21: Elwel will not speak to me.
sisterfight.30: One matter that the sisters disagree on currently is the color of a certain potion that the town potion-maker Hjaldar used to make. Elwyl says that the potion of accuracy focus that Hjaldar used to make was a blue potion, but Elwel insists that the potion was a green substance.
sisterfight.31: Elwyl wants me to get a potion of accuracy focus from Hjaldar here in Remgard so that she can finally prove to Elwel that she is wrong.
sisterfight.40: I have talked to Hjaldar in Remgard. Hjaldar no longer makes potions since his supply of Lyson marrow extract has gone dry.
sisterfight.41: Apparently, Hjaldar's old friend Mazeg would surely have some Lyson marrow extract to sell. Unfortunately, he does not know where Mazeg currently lives. He only knows that Mazeg traveled far to the west last time they met.
sisterfight.45: I should find Mazeg and get some Lyson marrow extract so that Hjaldar can start making potions again.
sisterfight.50: I have talked to Mazeg in the Blackwater mountain settlement. Since I helped the people of the Blackwater mountain before, he is willing to sell me a vial of Lyson marrow extract for only 400 gold.
sisterfight.51: I have talked to Mazeg in the Blackwater mountain settlement. He is willing to sell me Lyson marrow extract for 800 gold.
sisterfight.55: I have bought some Lyson marrow extract from Mazeg. I should return to Remgard and give it to Hjaldar.
sisterfight.60: Hjaldar thanked me for bringing him the marrow extract.
sisterfight.61: Hjaldar can now create potions again, and is willing to trade with me. He even gave me some of the first potions that he made. I should go visit the Elwille sisters here in Remgard again, and show them a potion of accuracy focus.
sisterfight.70: I have given a potion of accuracy focus to Elwyl.
sisterfight.71: Unfortunately, it did not cause their squabbling to diminish. On the contrary, they seem to be even more angry at each other now, since both of them had the color wrong.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
